ui.name: Nevada Department of Employment, Training and Rehabilitation (DETR), Employment Security Division

efile.text: Employers are required to file Unemployment Insurance Contribution Reports electronically under NAC Chapter 612, unless a waiver has been formally approved by the agency (waiver requests must reach DETR at least 30 days before the report is due). If the amount due is $10,000 or more, Nevada law requires the payment to be made electronically.

returns.name: Employer's Quarterly Contribution and Wage Report (Employer Self-Service)
contents: Received by the last day of the first month after the quarter: April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31 (2026 Q3 November 2, 2026; Q4 February 1, 2027); a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday moves it to the next business day. Online reports and payments should be completed by 5:00 p.m. Pacific time on the due date.
Total gross wages (including tips) are reported for every employee every quarter, even above the taxable wage limit; tax is due only up to the limit.
Filed online in Employer Self-Service (nui.nv.gov/ess); payment electronically when $10,000 or more is due; the Online Reporting Help Desk is (866) 429-9757.
(Dates and limits come from a secondary source; see the profile's first source.)
